summary: Asia Pacific Wire & Cable Corporation Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 14, 2026, reporting its Q2 2026 financial results via press release. The filing covers revenue of $136.6 million, up 8% year-over-year, operating profit of $3.4 million, and EPS of $0.01. No special-situation transaction—such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, spin-off, or restructuring—is described. The report is a routine quarterly earnings announcement, and the weighted average share increase reflects a prior February 2026 share issuance, not a current corporate action. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal terms are mentioned. This is an ordinary financial disclosure with no special-situations angle.
